words: Publisher 0.2.0 for cell DB-b-279. build_series gains present_dates and calendar arguments. When present_dates is given it appends, after drawdown_episodes, unreported_trading_days (the sorted trading days in (first_data_date, as_of] that no present partition holds, counted by lib/trading_calendar) and unreported_trading_days_basis (the fixed text), and it refuses present_dates without a calendar; when present_dates is None the document is today's. income is now the gold column as it stands, so a null stays null and is never 0.0. validate_against_contract grades the pair (both or neither, the fixed basis, a strictly increasing ISO list inside the window, no present day) through one nested helper. The module adds two constants and the pure function unreported_days. The 49 Financial series and its gzip bytes are byte-identical to commit df2468cbc8 on a synthetic fixture, and its manifest differs only in publisher_version. NOT proven: that any function writes the Cottonwood series; that is DB-b-280 and then a pair-gated run. Also NOT proven: that the 0.3.0 contract is merged, since it is held on another branch.
